name: pi-extensions
description: Bun workspace for independently published Pi extensions

scripts.build:all: bun run clean:dist && bun run build:extensions
scripts.test: bun run build:all && node --import tsx --test --test-isolation=process tests/todo.test.ts
scripts.check: bun run check:privacy && bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.pack:pi-todo: bun run --cwd extensions/pi-todo build && bun pm pack --dry-run --cwd dist/pi-todo
scripts.pack:check: bun run check && bun run pack:pi-todo

author: capdiem <capdiem@live.com>
